definitions.explanation: A tall mirror in which one can see one's entire body from head to toe. Used for checking one's appearance before going out.

examples.japanese: {姿見|すがたみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦チェックした→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked my whole body in the full-length mirror.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{姿見|すがたみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I have a full-length mirror in the entryway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{姿見|すがたみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Before going out, I stand in front of the full-length mirror and check that there is nothing wrong with my outfit.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (figure, appearance) + ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (seeing, viewing) — literally a mirror for seeing one's full figure. {姿見|すがたみ} specifically refers to a tall mirror that shows the entire body.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姿見|すがたみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand in front of a full-length mirror
- {姿見|すがたみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧: to be reflected in a full-length mirror
- {姿見|すがたみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to place a full-length mirror

VS. OTHER MIRROR WORDS:
- ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧: mirror (general term — any size)
- {姿見|すがたみ}: full-length mirror specifically
- ⟦{手鏡|てかがみ}→手鏡：16020_tekagami⟧: hand mirror

CULTURAL NOTE:
Commonly placed in the ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ (entryway) of Japanese homes for a final outfit check before going out.
